technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Organic production

# Included processes
The inventory includes the processes of soil cultivation, sowing, weed control, fertilisation, pest and pathogen control, harvest and drying of the grains. Machine infrastructure and a shed for machine sheltering is included. Inputs of fertilisers and seed as well as their transports to the regional processing center (10km) are considered. The direct emissions on the field are also included.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data were compiled from statistics, pilot network, fertilising recommendations, documents from extension services, information provided by retailers and expert knowledge. The production data were verified and adjusted by a group of experts.
